create_wav2vec2_bert_model: create a Wav2Vec2BertModel from Wav2Vec2BertConfig for audio feature extraction with encoder and adapter layers
run_wav2vec2_bert_ctc: run Wav2Vec2BertForCTC to transcribe audio input features into token sequences with CTC loss
build_sequence_classifier: build a Wav2Vec2BertForSequenceClassification model to classify audio inputs into label categories
build_xvector_extractor: build a Wav2Vec2BertForXVector model to extract speaker embeddings from audio input features
build_audio_frame_classifier: build a Wav2Vec2BertForAudioFrameClassification model to classify each audio frame into token labels
